messages:
harper: Hey folks, starting next Monday — couple quick security/onboarding clarifications before Day 1:
1) Can I use my personal iPhone for MFA and Slack, or do you require a company phone for the first week?
2) I need temporary lab badge access for 3 days; who signs that off and is there a form?
3) Will I be in the phishing sim right away and will failures be visible to my manager?

people-ops: Welcome @harper :wave: TL;DR - personal phone is fine for MFA but if you access corp email/apps you must install the BYOD MDM profile. Badge = manager request + security approval via form. Phishsim = enrolled within 3 business days, failures trigger a micro-training and a note to security + manager for repeat fails.

security: Hi @harper f4bb A few specifics: BYOD MDM enforces passcode + device encryption and only takes posture metadata. It will not read personal files. If you decline BYOD, we can provision a temporary company phone for 30 days. For badge access to labs we require completion of the 10-min data handling micro-training before issuance.

it-team: @harper For the badge put the dates and reason into https://it.redwood.internal/badge-requests and have your manager approve it. For urgent same-week access mark "urgent" and include the lab name & safety training certificate. We'll provision via facilities once approved.

phishsim-bot: Scheduled phish simulation enrollment: harper added to "new-hires-default" cohort. First simulated phish will be delivered ~3 business days after thread_ts. Failure results: automatic 20-min remedial training; repeated failures escalate to manager notification.

harper: Awesome, thanks all. One last quick one: do you have a recommended password manager for contractors? I use a personal vault but want to ensure company access patterns align.

people-ops: Use our approved list: 1Password (recommended) or LastPass Enterprise if previously provisioned. Contractors should use the company vault for repo/service creds; personal vaults for personal items only. We'll add you to the contractor vault on Day 1.

harper: Great — I'll enroll in 1Password tonight and file the badge request. Appreciate the help! :thumbsup:
